Market today: Mixed signals. Japan's strong chip exports suggest underlying demand, but "Nvidia turmoil" and widespread tech outages point to caution and potential weakness in your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: Your leveraged chip ETFs are bleeding heavily: SOXL is down -78.17%, MUU -61.79%, and SMCI -44.99%. Crucially, your QQQ stop at 670 is already breached (current 656.95), and SPY's stop at 705 is close. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on how the chip sector reacts to conflicting news (positive exports vs. Nvidia concerns). Also, monitor SPY and QQQ closely for further breakdown below their stops.

Bottom line: With significant losses and margin exposure, aggressive risk management and stop adherence are your top priorities.
plays: Your QQQ stop at 670 is breached (current 656.95). Consider trimming or exiting QQQ to manage risk.
Your SOXL (-78.17%) and MUU (-61.79%) stops are far from current prices. Re-evaluate these stops to reflect current market conditions and your risk tolerance.
CRWD is up 25.52% and marked "TRIM." Consider taking some profits here to reduce overall margin exposure and rebalance.
